linkedin.text:
Not every group wants a nightclub. Some want the opposite — and that brief is harder to deliver well.

This is our group on the Amalfi cliffs, on a programme built around long lunches, small boats and one very good dinner. No headline act. No LED wall. The itinerary was deliberately thin, because the point was to give people back their attention.

Quiet programmes fail when they are under-produced rather than under-scheduled. The restaurant still has to hold the whole group. The boats still have to leave on time. The gap in the afternoon still has to be a choice, not a collapse.

If your team is tired rather than under-entertained, this is the shape of trip to ask us for.

Uproduction Events — From Business to Pleasure

📩 alon@upe.co.il
